blocks.text: Puget Sound Condo & Townhome Painting

At Black Pearl Painters, we bring color and life to homes and businesses across the Puget Sound, Washington area. With years of experience and a passion for precision, our team delivers exceptional painting services tailored to your needs.
Whether you’re refreshing your  interior, updating your exterior, or enhancing your commercial space, we’re here to make your vision a reality.

Our commitment to quality sets us apart. We use premium paints and materials, combined with expert techniques, to ensure a flawless finish that lasts. From meticulous surface preparation to the final brushstroke, every step is handled with care.
Serving the Puget Sound region, we understand the unique needs of local homeowners and businesses, and we’re proud to be a trusted name in painting services.
Specialized Expertise in Condo and Townhome Painting
We understand the unique challenges of painting condos and townhomes, such as working within COA/TOA/HOA guidelines, navigating shared spaces, and ensuring minimal disruption to neighbors.

Whether it’s refreshing a rural condo or central city townhome, our team, led by experts like Justin and Kirk, uses premium paints and meticulous techniques to achieve flawless finishes that enhance both aesthetics and property value. The focus on detail ensures your space stands out while adhering to Puget Sound’s community standards.
Proven Customer Satisfaction with a 4.9-Star Reputation

Black Pearl Painters boasts a 4.9-star rating from satisfied clients across Puget Sound, reflecting our commitment to excellence in condo and townhome painting projects.  We are often recognized for our professionalism, punctuality, and ability to transform spaces, whether it’s a cozy condo interior or a townhome’s exterior facade.
Reviews highlight our seamless communication and ability to exceed expectations, such as on a recent project in Proctor where they revitalized a 50-year-old condo with a fresh, modern look.
With Black Pearl Painters, you’re choosing a trusted partner who delivers stunning results and ensures your Puget Sound property shines.
Tailored Solutions for Puget Sound’s Condo and Townhome Communities
As a local Puget Sound painting company, Black Pearl Painters knows the city’s diverse neighborhoods and architectural styles, from Rustic Cabin to the Farmhouse, we’ve painted them all.

We offer customized painting solutions that complement Puget Sound’s unique vibe, using weather-resistant exterior paints to combat the Pacific Northwest’s rainy climate and low-VOC interior paints for a safe, eco-friendly finish.

We also provide flexible scheduling to accommodate condo and townhome residents, ensuring projects are completed efficiently—perfect for busy professionals or families preparing for events like the Tacoma Dome’s spring season.
Why Black Pearl Painters?
Serving the Puget Sound with Local Expertise

As a locally owned and operated business, we’re deeply connected to the communities we serve. In Puget Sound, we’ve painted historic homes and modern apartments, bringing vibrancy to every neighborhood. Our exterior painting withstands the Pacific Northwest’s weather, protecting homes year-round. Puget Sound’s businesses rely on us for professional finishes that attract customers, while in Puget Sound, our residential projects add charm to family homes.

We know the local climate and architectural styles, allowing us to recommend the best paints and techniques for durability and beauty. Our team is fully licensed, insured, and trained to handle projects of all sizes, giving you peace of mind.
